stories.title: Australia news live: Sydney trains plagued by morning cancellations due to ‘urgent’ repairs to overhead wires
stories.summary: Commuters warned journey may take an extra 45 minutes as ‘limited’ buses replace north short trains. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Transport for NSW has put on “limited” buses replacing trains for Sydney’s north shore this morning, with major cancellations and delays across multiple lines. The problem, we’re told , is “urgent overhead wiring repairs at Chatswood”. Limited buses are replacing trains from Gordon, all stations to Chatswood only due to urgent overhead wiring repairs at Chatswood.
